value.rationale: A motivated complete classification of every two-shift pseudoperiod in the canonical uncountable aperiodic Sturmian family. The single sharp fractional-part separation threshold replaces an implicit slope-specific automaton, distinguishes valid from invalid pairs, proves intercept invariance, and yields infinitely many valid pairs. Not merely the known existence proposition or the known Fibonacci subcase.
